summary.text: David Cook is a Republican state representative from Texas House District 96 who is running for Texas State Senate District 22 and is on the November 3, 2026 ballot for both a special election and the regular general election for that seat. An attorney and small business owner, he has served in the House since January 2021.

paragraphs.text: David Cook graduated from Mansfield High School, earned a bachelor's degree from Stephen F. Austin State University in 1992 and received a law degree from Texas A&M University in 1996, according to Ballotpedia.
His career experience includes work as a legislative aide for a former state senator and as a law clerk, associate attorney and managing partner with the Harris Cook law firm.
Cook assumed office in the Texas House of Representatives on January 12, 2021, succeeding Bill Zedler in District 96.
In 2023-2024 he was assigned to the Calendars and Juvenile Justice & Family Issues committees.
He advanced from the Republican primary for Texas State Senate District 22 on March 3, 2026, and is not running for re-election to the House.
